create_seq2seq_trainer: create a Seq2SeqTrainer instance for fine-tuning a sequence-to-sequence model with custom datasets and metrics
load_generation_config: load a GenerationConfig from a path string or model ID for sequence-to-sequence model generation
run_evaluate: run evaluation on a seq2seq model with generation kwargs like max_length and num_beams for metrics computation
run_predict: run prediction on a test dataset using seq2seq model generate with configurable generation parameters
review_prediction_step: review the prediction_step method that performs seq2seq generation and computes loss with padded tensors
